title: Help in finding tutorial s for RPG Maker MZ

posts.author: midorinix
posts.body: This is my second post after my kind of failed attempt at creating a game. I want to learn how to use the engine, but I don't really know from where I should start. What do you guys recommend? What tutorials should I follow to learn this engine?

posts.author: FrigidGaze
posts.body: Hiya! Are there any particular aspects you may be struggling with in particular? And have you gone through the built-in tutorial first? You can find it near the top in the 'Help' dropdown menu and I believe it takes you through a lot of the basics in an interactive fashion!

posts.author: midorinix
posts.body: I am having trouble in creating custom chat boxes and battle UIs, and also with some events not unfolding as I wish. It would be really helpful if I could find someone to teach me and answer my questions, but I don't know where to find a "teacher" or maybe more complex tutorials (sorry if my english is bad)

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Stop trying to "learn the engine" and google what your specific progblem is. Anything relating to menus, huds, windows, you'll need a plugin.
If you have any specific problem google can't find for you, you can always ask questions here.
A simple thread with "Here's what I'm trying to make (screenshot of what you made), here's what happens instead (Screenshot of the thing going wrong) and how do I fix this?" Will get you replies almost guaranteed.
There's no "Teacher" that just heeds your every call, especially not for free.

posts.author: midorinix
posts.body: Okay, I understand. Thanks a lot!

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
So I actually think it is great idea to recreate tutorials until you become quite familiar with the basics of using MZ. I am copying the same information I posted in another thread with recommendations.
I have a bunch of tutorials on my YouTube channel, but those make the assumption that you already know the basics. Since I focused my tutorials on things I learned that I hadn't seen a tutorial for.
It is great to hear that you actually want to do tutorials! So many people seem to sort of want to skip over the learning MZ part and jump right in with I want to make something NOW!
I can make a few recommendations. The first, of course, is doing the MZ built in tutorial. I had a couple of problems with it when I started about 3 years ago, but it could have just been new person errors on my part.
There are quite a few content creators that have entire series of tutorials on YouTube. Most of them are still completely correct although some things could have changed over the years.
What I did was I searched for RPG MAKER MZ TUTORIALS and then looked for the top rated tutorials. Those are usually the ones who have been around the longest. Then I checked to see which videos were part of playlists. Then I looked at the playlists to see how many tutorials there were and what they covered.
I ended up just picking one to go all the way through. Then I sort of just spot picked tutorials from other series. And Caz has a series of 100 second videos that explain certain things pretty quickly.
And when I was recreating the tutorials, I also branched out and experimented on ideas as the inspiration hit me. That is also very useful.
Here are a few examples of creators with entire playlists that you might check out.
https://www.youtube.com/@LvLUpDesign/playlists
https://www.youtube.com/@rpggamemaker6684/playlists
https://www.youtube.com/@TheOdie/playlists
https://www.youtube.com/@DriftyG/playlists
https://www.youtube.com/@Cazwolf/playlists
Anyway, I hope some of these are helpful! I think I did the RPG Gamer Maker series along with samplings of other series. And some of these are new to me, but look interesting.
I don't specifically recommend my own tutorials because I sort of assume that anyone watching mine has already done more basic tutorials. Mine are just things I have experimented and built that I think might be helpful for someone.
I hope this helps and good luck on your projects!

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
midorinix said:
What tutorials should I follow to learn this engine?
Click to expand...
Have you done the tutorials built into MZ? Right in the Help menu?
Aside from that, there are many YouTube series for MV and MZ (they're functionally the same, except for the mapping layers) - Echo607, SRD, Driftwood Gaming, Caz, etc. All you have to do is Google "rpg maker mz tutorials" and you get pages of results.
Aside from that, your questions appear to be a mix of what you can do in the editor (events) and what you need plugins for (customizing the UI).

posts.author: ISC
posts.body:
I follow a dev who creates games with RPG Maker MZ and often does streams where he shares the creation of an entire mini-game, from start to finish. However, his knowledge is already quite advanced, and he often creates custom scripts and codes for his games. I'm not sure if something like this would be useful to you; it depends on your current level of knowledge with RPG Maker. If posting links to streamers doesn’t go against the forum rules, I could share the link with you (I need to check the forum rules on this point)
You might want to check out this streamer. When designing a game on RPG Maker MZ or MV, he shows the entire creative and programming process. The mechanics he comes up with are truly incredible and delightfully crazy. However, I should warn you that his knowledge of the tool is quite advanced, so he rarely covers basic content.
He usually dedicates one day a week for streams on creating with RPG Maker MZ
